attempts.summary: Configured root cron job on node1 to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Also repaired the script file, which had been corrupted by a botched heredoc during provisioning (it contained literal leftover shell commands as text and was not executable). Verified functionality, then performed the mandatory single-node restart, confirming boot identity change and post-restart recovery of crond, the crontab entry, script permissions, and the log file.
